messages.content: Delta canceled tomorrow’s Atlanta-to-Denver flight. I need to protect Tuesday’s inspection, but don’t disturb Wednesday’s return or the hotel. What are the replacement choices?

There are three workable Monday options. Delta can move you at no charge to a 7:20 p.m. nonstop arriving at 8:46 p.m. local time. Delta also has a 12:10 p.m. departure through Minneapolis, arriving at 4:38 p.m., but the connection is only 42 minutes. United has a 2:35 p.m. nonstop arriving at 4:04 p.m.; it costs $238 more than the value of the canceled segment.
The documentation case still has to be checked. How much risk does that add to Minneapolis?

Delta would check the 46-pound case through to Denver, and the connection is legal, but 42 minutes leaves little recovery time if the first flight is delayed. You could reach Denver without the case even if you make the connection. The evening nonstop avoids that transfer risk, though it would put you at the hotel after 9:30 p.m.

Use the United nonstop. The extra cost is worth arriving early enough to organize the inspection materials. Rebook Monday only, with the case checked. Keep Delta 1472 Wednesday evening; a later departure works well after the collection release.

The United replacement is available. Its $238 incremental fare is nonrefundable, and United will charge $35 for the checked case. Your carry-on suitcase remains included. I’ll leave Delta 1472, seat 19A, and the Hyatt reservation unchanged.
Go ahead, and make sure Delta refunds only the canceled outbound portion. Then tell the hotel when I’ll arrive.

The Monday United flight is ticketed, and Delta has submitted a $243.00 refund to the original payment method for the canceled outbound segment only. Delta 1472 on Wednesday remains active under G7R4QK. I’m contacting Hyatt Place Denver/Cherry Creek with an expected Monday arrival around 5:15 p.m.
Give me the final amended record and confirm the hotel received that.

Amended record: Monday, November 9, United 621 departs ATL at 2:35 p.m. and arrives DEN at 4:04 p.m., confirmation U6P9LT. The added fare is $238.00, with a $35.00 checked-case fee due at check-in; your suitcase is carry-on. Delta’s canceled outbound is being refunded at $243.00, while Wednesday’s Delta 1472 at 8:15 p.m., seat 19A, remains unchanged under G7R4QK. Hyatt Place Denver/Cherry Creek confirmed the updated arrival note for approximately 5:15 p.m.; reservation HPC-739284 and Tuesday’s luggage arrangements are unchanged.
